Hawaii Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Plans (June 10th - June 20th, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, backpack)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Camera and extra batteries
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel reservations)
- Sunglasses and hat
- Beach towel
- Flip flops
- Water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- First aid kit
- Cash and credit cards
- Phone charger and power bank
- Travel adapter
- Toiletries (travel size)
- Rain jacket or umbrella
- Insect repellent
